items.title: barnabemonnot：这类攻击提醒我们，对很多资产而言，目标应是让以太坊不仅是传输层，也是登记发行地；有效性证明与快速最终性是消除延迟、与更快的替代方案竞争的关键
items.title_en: barnabemonnot: hacks like these remind us that for many assets the goal should be to make Ethereum not only the transport layer but also the issuer of record; validity proofs and fast finality are essential to remove latency and compete with faster alternatives

summary_en: The rsETH bridge incident kept unfolding: LefterisJP noted LayerZero and Kelp blaming each other while Aave stayed silent, and potuz argued Aave's risk curators deserve the blame. barnabemonnot said that for many assets the goal should be making Ethereum not only the transport layer but also the issuer of record. Two EIP-8037 state gas rules were merged.
